sourceNotes.scope: 35 new sends after Batch 108: 30 catalog sends and five non-catalog private project/maintenance messages. No reply, commitment, phone call, order or booking sent.
sourceNotes.branches: The Baked Bear uses Glenn’s supplied 303 Columbus Ave branch. Grand-O’s Chase Center review is clearly marked as another location. Arsicault uses 87 McAllister, matching the supplied phone; all three official branch contacts/menu links are in its panel. No duplicate unrequested branch pages.
sourceNotes.menus: Full published Columbus Avenue pickup sections: 35 rows (the official categories repeat one sandwich), excluding repeated Most Ordered promotions. Full official Civic Center menu: 51 rows. Prices are not inferred from reels. Other Arsicault menus remain linked rather than mixed into the Civic Center menu.
sourceNotes.films: Two explicitly requested owner films become Scoop N Chill and Arsicault heroes, with original posting credits. The 2023 Arsicault event is archival, not a current offer. Four films maximum per business: existing Sisi review remains linked on Scoop and plays on her creator page/Watch; Kath and both Char clips play on their creator pages/Watch and remain linked from Arsicault. All ten new films are local; none held.
